note: Editor toolbar buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editing actions (e.g., Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, etc.)
Editor toolbar toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view/edit modes (e.g., Word Wrap, Show Line Numbers, etc.)
View mode radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for layout selection (e.g., Single, Dual, etc.)
Preferences/Options checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for feature toggles (e.g., Highlight Syntax, Show Spaces, etc.)
Status bar and toolbar labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for UI state and section headers (e.g., Ln, Col, Encoding, etc.)
